input.args: Write an ADR documenting why pickup reminders go by SMS instead of email, so the next volunteer who proposes switching to email (to save cost) has an answer. Source material: notes/issue-52.md (Leo proposed switching to email to save ~40€/month; Marta said it was tried before; Nadia reported that April–June 2025 the team tried email and 34% of reminder emails were never opened, missed pickups rose from 6% to 13% of pantry orders; Tom confirmed switching back to SMS on July 1, 2025 brought missed pickups back down to 6% by August; Ana (maintainer) decided to keep SMS and closed the issue). The code is larder/reminders.py, which hard-codes CHANNEL = "sms". There is no existing ADR for this (only docs/adr/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md exists) and no reminders feature page under docs/features/. Determine whether this belongs as a new ADR, a note in an existing page, or something else per the docs/README.md criteria, then write it, following the project's ADR template/conventions, and update docs/adr/README.md's index.

last_message: I've added `docs/adr/0002-remind-pickups-by-sms.md`, recording why `larder/reminders.py` hard-codes SMS: a 2025 email trial saw 34% of reminders go unopened and missed pickups rise from 6% to 13%, reverting to 6% once SMS came back. It's indexed in `docs/adr/README.md` and links back to `notes/issue-52.md` as the source thread, so the next proposer has a documented answer.
